newsitem.title: ITALY: ITALY MIF FUTURES TO LOSE SIX MARKET MAKERS AUG 18.
newsitem.headline: ITALY MIF FUTURES TO LOSE SIX MARKET MAKERS AUG 18.

text.p: The number of market makers operating on Italy's MIF bond futures market will fall to 17 from 23 from August 18, the Bank of Italy said.
The central bank said the banks and securities houses leaving the list were Banca Nazionale dell'Agricoltura, Banco di Sardegna SARI.MI, Banque Paribas, Cariverona, Imi Sigeco and Ing Bank.

Those confirmed in their role were Banca Commerciale Italiana, Monte Paschi di Siena, Banca del Salento, Banca di Roma, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro, Banca Popolare di Milano, Banca Sella, Banco Sicilia, Caboto, Cariplo, Cassa Risparmio di Torino, Creberg, Credito Italiano, Deutsche Bank, Eptasim, San Paolo and Mediobanca.

The period used to check on operating criteria was March 6 to June 6. The central bank took into account all operations carried out on quoted futures without requiring a minimum quantity of contracts traded.
Market sources said the six operators cancelled from the list had shown less than market average activity in the period.
